descriptions.text: Kannagi Finance, a yield aggregator on zkSync pulled the rug on Saturday, dropping TVL from $2.1M to $0.17. The auditors may have highlighted 'centralised aspects' but, in this industry, who reads the fine print?

Kannagi Finance has rug pulled, making away with up to $2.13 million in investor funds. The platform runs o the zkSync Era, which is in the race for the best Ethereum Layer 2 network. The network has deleted its official website, including social media and communication accounts.

Kannagi Finance, a zkSync Era yield aggregator, was drained of over $2.1 million in user funds in late July 2023 after its closed-source, upgradeable contracts allowed operators to deploy malicious logic and exit with all assets. No funds have been recovered, and all supporting evidence comes from public incident catalogues and press, not direct on-chain references. Kannagi Finance's team retained unilateral control over upgradeable, closed-source vault contracts. This allowed them to deploy a malicious contract version to drain all deposited funds, executing an admin-enabled rug pull.
